PASSAGE: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has sparked a global debate regarding its impact on the future of labor. While optimists argue that AI will create new, high-value jobs and automate mundane tasks, skeptics warn of widespread displacement of workers in traditional sectors. Proponents of 'Human-AI Collaboration' suggest that the most successful organizations will be those that integrate AI as a tool to augment human capabilities rather than replace them entirely. However, this transition requires a significant shift in education and training, focusing on 'soft skills' like critical thinking, empathy, and ethical judgment—areas where machines still struggle to compete with humans.

Which of the following best summarizes the main idea of the passage?
options: Soft skills are more important than technical skills in every industry.
The future of work depends on the successful integration of AI and human skills.
AI will inevitably replace all human labor in the next decade.
Education systems are currently incapable of handling the AI transition.

The high cost of implementing AI technology.
